name: Ash Crust
description: A crust of grey ash over dead soil, cracked in hexagons where it dried.
role: The base ground of the Ash Wastes.

artBrief.spriteScale: Seamless square tile. Floor entities tile it over a 4×4 cell footprint.
artBrief.silhouette: Flat tile with faint hexagonal cracks.
artBrief.detail: Soot lines in the cracks; loose ash drifts along one edge.
artBrief.paletteDirection: Ash greys, bone white highlights, black soot.
